budget.why_it_matters: at 808 B of headroom the baseline was 1.2% from the cap; one more paragraph would have made a live session receive a TRUNCATED manual
budget.eol_hazard_measured: .gitattributes pins `*.md text eol=lf`, so the manual is LF in every working tree; but a file NOT named *.md matches only `* text=auto` and IS checked out CRLF on Windows. Measured: AGENTS.md.before reads 65,163 B / 739 CRLF in a Windows working tree against its 64,424 B LF blob (+1 B per line). Un-normalized, the baseline would render 65,467 B = 69 B of headroom instead of 808. The instrument now normalizes EOL, reports raw_source_bytes/eol_as_read, and asserts post_eol_is_lf.

preservation.instrument: evidence/gates/agents-budget/20260923T085717Z-slim/preservation-audit.mjs (plus prose-loss-sweep.mjs and crossref-check.mjs, added by the re-verification pass)
preservation.why_a_new_instrument: T-22's move-audit.mjs demanded BYTE-IDENTITY per segment because that wave only MOVED text. This change COMPRESSES text, so byte-identity is the wrong instrument; this one asks the questions a compression must still answer (contract survival, a fully triaged token census, a prose-level sweep, and citation resolution).

prose_sweep.instrument: prose-loss-sweep.mjs — for every SENTENCE of the old manual, does any 6-word run survive anywhere in the new one? This closes the gap a token check cannot see (prose-only loss, e.g. the role descriptions that are not code spans).
prose_sweep.reading: TRIAGE LIST, not a verdict: a fully REWRITTEN sentence also lands here, which is the expected shape for a compression. Each of the 79 was inspected and falls into: reworded-rule-intact (the large majority), §3 tree reflow (three real role losses repaired), or a deliberate example trim already ledgered with its reason.

crossref.reading: every §N citation inside the manual AND every explicit `AGENTS.md §N` citation anywhere in the repository still names a section that exists

§1's emphatic roster correction 'NOT presets' and the two env-key descriptors ('the sg resolver' / 'codegraph serve') were dropped => restored

a needle or token split across a line break - the instrument compares REFLOW-NORMALIZED text, and reports literal-only matches apart as contractsPresentOnlyAfterReflow
markdown EMPHASIS markers (**bold**, `code`) made a surviving rule shingle differently - prose-loss-sweep.mjs flattens them on both sides before comparing

independent_review.delegation_history: the roster Reviewer path was commissioned TWICE and returned an EMPTY final message both times (no verdict, no findings) — not counted as a review; the THIRD attempt via the plain subagent path produced the substantive report summarised here
independent_review.binding_rule_loss: NONE — the reviewer read both files end-to-end, walked all 13 sections, re-ran both repo gates, scored every BEFORE sentence containing MUST/NEVER/binding/refuse/deny/do-not/exactly/only, and opened the files the manual names (scripts/verify-gates.mjs, package.json, the three package build scripts, three committed dist artifacts, scripts/verify-docs-parity.mjs, packages/mpd-dsh-adapter-plugin/src/index.ts, agent-references/index.md, the roles/workmate deny lists)

findings.what: the bypass-test pointer was spelled `test/adapter-bypass-inventory.test.mjs` — no root `test/` dir exists; verify-manual-paths bucketed it as over-report:notRoot so it could not fail, and the §4 row added by this same change over-claimed that the gate audits every code-span path token
findings.repair: pointer re-spelled package-relative (now root-anchored, so the gate AUDITS it: audited 106 -> 107) and the §4 row now states the gate's real bucket rule

findings.what: the Language-policy bullet points at `(see §3)` for the bilingual exemption classes, but §3's docs/ line had been compressed to a bare description — 8 docs/*.md files carry `<!-- docs-parity: exempt … (AGENTS.md §3) -->` and the docs gate itself prints 'process record (AGENTS.md §3: plan-*.md)', so all of them pointed at an emptied target
findings.verified_by_author: CONFIRMED — 8 docs + 6 gate-source citations; §3 no longer contained 'exempt'/'process record'
findings.repair: the exemption sentence is restored in §3's docs/ line, so every citation resolves again without touching a gate script

findings.what: the Build bullet asserted a present-tense fact about three named files ('the form mpd-ext-plugin, mpd-team-watchdog-plugin and mpd-tui-plugin STILL CARRY in their own build scripts') — all three already use the canonical root-qualified form
findings.verified_by_author: CONFIRMED — all three build scripts begin `cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && bun build packages/…`, dist/sdk.js carries the root-relative comment, and fix 39793669 IS an ancestor of the baseline (so BEFORE's hedge was already stale)
findings.repair: the trap is now stated as a rule (a PACKAGE-directory build is flagged STALE) with the three packages described as having USED that shape, moved to the canonical form by T-67

instrument_blind_spots_the_reviewer_iden: crossref-check.mjs proves only that a §N EXISTS, so an EMPTIED §3 body passes it (F2)
preservation-audit.mjs checks needles that live in the Language policy, so it could not see that the §3 pointer TARGET had been emptied (F2)

NO instrument opens the files the manual NAMES, so a wrong path spelling bucketed as an over-report is invisible to all of them (F1) — the one instrument that does open them is the path gate, and its own bucket rule is what hid it
prose-loss-sweep.mjs DID list the T-67 sentence as unmatched (its entry 69); it was trimmed rather than re-verified against the tree (F3)
LESSON: a needle must be checked at its TARGET; a prose-sweep hit must be opened against the tree; an instrument that cannot see a class of defect must not be reported as if it covered it
could_not_verify_on_this_host: bun run verify:gates, node scripts/verify-dist-fresh.mjs, node scripts/mpd-bg.mjs --self-test and bun test are blocked by child-spawn BUILD_FAILED/EPERM on piped stdio, so F3 rests on the build scripts plus the committed dist comments rather than on the gate
the 'lib/client.js is still the 0.1.14 client build' claim (that bundle carries no version string) and the T-44 installed-harness-row claim — both unchanged from BEFORE

verify_manual_paths.note: the F1 repair made the bypass-test pointer ROOT-ANCHORED, so the gate now audits and resolves it; the earlier over-report:notRoot entry for `test/...` is gone

verify_docs_parity.note: AGENTS.md still carries its A1–D42 derived-value claim, checked against the registry table

qa_case_substring.assertion: AGENTS.md includes "Adopted plugins keep their plugin ids and tool names"

verify_gates_aggregate.reading: all 5 members FAIL with 'spawn error: EPERM' (the sandbox denies node->node piped stdio), so each member was run directly

caveats: agent-teams-adopt --self-test is RED on this host and the manual is NOT the cause: its AGENTS.md assertion passes when run directly, and it then fails inside install-profile.mjs --self-test, which was red directly ('sidebar guard drifted from the bundle patch') because of an in-flight uncommitted mpd-bundle-plugin sidebar change in the working tree at the time (since committed by the captain). The case also spawns a child with piped stdio, which is EPERM under this sandbox independently of the tree state.

verify-manual-paths was RED in the baseline run (unresolved=1 - .mpd/plans) and is green now because the manual no longer spells that gitignored runtime directory in a code span. The gate's verdict therefore depended on transient workspace state; the recommended follow-up is to classify .mpd/** as runtime state in the GATE, not to re-add a claim that a transient directory exists.

The independent review took THREE attempts: the roster Reviewer path returned an empty final message twice (not a review), and the third attempt (plain subagent) produced a substantive report with verdict needs_revision, NO binding rule lost, and three real findings — all three verified against the tree by the author and repaired (see independent_review). Its critique of the instruments' blind spots is recorded there because the author's own four PASS instruments could not see any of the three defects.

EOL HYGIENE: the first commit of these evidence files stored LF blobs correctly, but on a Windows checkout every evidence file whose name is not *.md/*.ts/*.yml is re-materialized as CRLF by `* text=auto` (git warns 'LF will be replaced by CRLF the next time Git touches it'). The working copies were normalized back to LF (content-identical; git diff --numstat shows no content change for them). Recommended one-liner: add `evidence/** text eol=lf` to .gitattributes so a re-runner's baseline reading cannot be inflated by 1 B per line.
This change is manual-only: no gate script, no plugin source and no reference file's content was modified.
